course_name_original: German B2 course - compulsory course of 135 hours for students of FIRST-CYCLE studies - semester 2/3
course_name_en: German B2 course - compulsory course of 135 hours for students of FIRST-CYCLE studies - semester 2/3
prerequisites: German language proficiency at least at A-2 level.

learning_outcomes.text: Can write an understandable informational and argumentative text on general and industry-specific topics, conduct correspondence typical of the work environment, and independently use didactic materials.
Can clearly present their conclusions and opinions on general, academic, and professional topics in written and oral form.

Understands longer, even complex written and oral statements, e.g., lectures and presentations, provided they concern industry-specific issues and current affairs, and can interpret the acquired information.

Can use grammatical constructions, phraseology, and vocabulary that allow for understanding general texts describing contemporary economic and social phenomena, academic and industry-specific texts, and allow for fairly fluent and spontaneous communication in academic and professional environments.
Can prepare an oral presentation on academic and industry-specific topics and participate fairly fluently and spontaneously in discussions, also in a professional environment.

syllabus_topics: Subordinate clauses with weil, dass, obwohl, trotzdem
Temporal clauses with als, wenn, während, nachdem, seit, sobald, bis, bevor, solange
Compound conjunctions: je ... desto ..., nicht ... sondern ..., nicht nur ... sondern auch
Subjunctive mood: Konjunktiv Präteritum und Plusquamperfekt
Infinitive with and without "zu" - Infinitiv mit und ohne zu
Modal particles: denn, doch, ja, eigentlich, mal

Infinitive constructions: Infinitivkonstruktionen: um..zu, ohne
zu, anstatt
zu
Conjunctions: Konjuktionen: damit, ohne dass, anstatt dass
Adverbial clause of manner: Modalsatz indem, dadurch dass

Multi-part conjunctions: zwar
aber, einerseits
andererseits
Communication media - Kommunikatiosmedien, Computer und Internet
Holidays and celebrations - Feste und Feiertage
Education system in Germany and Poland - Schulen in Deutschland und in Polen
Climate and environment, weather, environmental pollution - Klima und Umwelt: Wetter, Umweltprobleme
Job application - Bewerbug, Suche nach der Arbeit
Finance, banking, conducting business phone calls - Fit für Finanzen, Fit am Telefon, Fit für die Firma
Studies, description of faculty and nature of studies
Talking about photos and memories - Über Fotos und Erinnerungen sprechen
Talking about everyday life situations - Über Alltagsprobleme sprechen
Naming conditions and consequences -Bedingungen und Konsequenzen nennen
Resolving conflicts, reacting in conflict situations -Konflikte erkennen, verstehen und lösen
Talking about rules of behavior and gestures -Über Verhaltensregeln und Gesten sprechen
Conducting short conversations with casually met people (Smalltalksituationen)
Proposing and arguing, presenting one's own position, constructive criticism
Preparing and conducting a job interview
Drafting various types of texts: emails and private and official letters, e.g., cover letter, CV, letters to the editor in response to a read article
Listening comprehension of interviews, general conversations, as well as popular science statements
Conducting a professional presentation related to the field of study
assessment_rules: To pass the course, a positive grade must be obtained from all colloquia conducted during the semester. If a negative grade is received, the student has the right to improve it. An unjustified absence from a test results in the loss of a term. The final grade is an arithmetic average of all grades obtained from passing individual semesters and the foreign language exam. Admission to the exam requires passing the compulsory language course semesters.
